subsystems.name: structures_mechanisms
subsystems.source: PDF §7.5.3 aggregate 32 bps; 8 microswitch bits, two 16-bit SADM encoders, two 16-bit HGA resolvers, six RTD channels at 0.2Hz. Encoder and resolver cadence/RTD bit depth assumed.
subsystems.notes: 4+8+8+12=32 bps. PDF specifies RTD 0.2Hz and encoder/resolver 16 bits; other cadences and RTD 10-bit are placeholders. Confirm whether 32 bps includes packet headers.
